## User-visible change

Describe the failing behavior or intended improvement, not only the code.

## Verification

Record commands, results, OS/toolchain and skipped/manual scope. Explain how the regression fails on the baseline. Automated metrics are not human acceptance.

## Compatibility and privacy

Describe Link host/viewer compatibility, persisted-state changes and network/data boundaries. No silent fallback that bypasses conflict checks.

## Documentation and remaining work

Link current guides/backlog items. Preserve historical evidence. State whether this is a candidate or a published release.
